about: Belleville is on the Bay of Quinte in eastern Ontario, at the mouth of the Moira River. It is a Loyalist-era city and a service centre for Hastings County, with a downtown along the harbour and Highway 401 on the inland side. The bay, a long-running farmers’ market, and nearby wine country on Prince Edward County shape local life. About 55,000 people live in Belleville.
